description: See how small monthly snowflake payments and one-time windfalls shorten a payoff and cut interest.
Compute net debt, net worth, debt-to-assets and leverage band from your full household balance sheet.
Project the calendar date you become debt-free and the milestones along the way with optional extra payments.
Measure personal leverage by comparing total debt with net worth, with liabilities-to-assets and non-mortgage detail.
Compare Rule of 78 and pro-rata rebates on a precomputed loan payoff and see the implied APR.
